lines.text: When Samuel grew old, he appointed his sons Joel and Abijah as judges in Beersheba.
His sons accepted bribes and perverted justice, so the elders came to Samuel at Gilgal and asked for a king.
Samuel prayed, and the LORD said the people had rejected Him as king and served other gods.
Samuel warned the king would take their sons for his chariots and their daughters to be weavers, cooks, and bakers.
The people refused to listen and demanded a king, so the LORD told Samuel to appoint one for them.
